title: Peak Loading, Blackout Days and Event Insurance Thresholds for Catering Service Levels
content:
Three figures are published against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement for the trading calendar and for insurance.

The **peak surcharge** is applied to orders served in the declared peak weeks, as a percentage. The **blackout days** are the published days in the year on which the service level takes no orders. The **insurance threshold** is the order value above which a certificate of event insurance is required, in USD.

| Service level | Peak surcharge | Blackout days | Insurance threshold |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 5.0 per cent | 6 | 0.00 USD |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 7.5 per cent | 6 | 0.00 USD |
| Attended Buffet Account | 10.0 per cent | 8 | 15000.00 USD |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 12.5 per cent | 10 | 25000.00 USD |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 15.0 per cent | 4 | 20000.00 USD |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 10.0 per cent | 12 | 50000.00 USD |

The peak surcharge peaks at 15.0 per cent on the Executive Hospitality Catering Account rather than on the largest level; the Campus Catering Master Account carries 10.0 per cent, the same figure as the Attended Buffet Account, against the longest blackout list in the schedule at 12 days.
